subject.title: fix: reconcile timed-out gateway message actions

question: Is same-process message-action reconciliation acceptable even though a gateway restart during the ambiguous delivery window can still permit a duplicate send?
rationale: Source establishes the bounded same-process behavior, but maintainers must choose whether the remaining delivery risk is acceptable.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Merge after a real delayed-send run proves exactly one visible delivery and track restart-durable idempotency separately.

options.title: Require restart durability
options.body: Pause until the message-action idempotency record survives gateway restarts.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Merge after a real delayed-send run proves exactly one visible delivery and track restart-durable idempotency separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway idempotency and message-action history makes this the strongest available decision owner.
